We start from your margins, not the platform's dashboard, and build the media, creative, retention and website around what a sale actually leaves behind.

How we work

Why not just a platform

The dashboard is not the whole story.

A platform reports what it wants to.

Meta, Google and your store each count sales their own way, so the totals never quite agree. We start from your store's real orders.

A ROAS number hides the loss.

A campaign can look healthy on ROAS and still lose money once product, shipping and returns are paid. We read every account against contribution margin.

Five vendors means five stories.

Media, creative, retention and the website are usually bought separately and never quite agree with each other. One team plans all four together.

A quarterly report is too late to matter.

By the time a slide deck says what went wrong, the budget is already spent. We read the numbers weekly and change course inside the month.
